name: ambideckstrous
description: MTG card search app (and eventual deck builder) — Express/MongoDB backend + React frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run build -w frontend

author: Zachary Sabourin
